maya.name: Maya Chen
maya.role: Lead engineer at a failing AI startup
maya.visual: East Asian woman in her late 20s, short straight black hair with subtle blue highlights, round wire-frame glasses, wearing an oversized dark purple hoodie with a small robot logo, dark jeans, white sneakers, confident posture but tired eyes, warm skin tone

derek.name: Derek Thompson
derek.role: Growth hacker at a crypto company that keeps pivoting
derek.visual: Tall Black man in his early 30s, immaculately trimmed short beard, confident smile, wearing a fitted navy blazer over a bright graphic tee with geometric patterns, slim khaki chinos, clean white leather shoes, silver watch

priya.name: Priya Sharma
priya.role: UX designer who secretly hates all technology
priya.visual: South Asian woman in her mid 20s, long dark wavy hair often in a loose side braid, warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a white blouse, colorful printed scarf, high-waisted olive green pants, brown ankle boots, always carrying a leather-bound sketchbook

finn.name: Finn O'Brien
finn.role: QA tester who finds bugs in everything including real life
finn.visual: Pale Irish man in his late 20s, messy curly red hair, light freckles across his nose, perpetually confused wide-eyed expression, wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt with palm trees over a plain white t-shirt, cargo shorts, worn sandals

living_room.trigger_word: Modern San Francisco apartment living room with a panoramic window showing the Bay Bridge at golden hour, cluttered with tech gadgets, a large whiteboard covered in diagrams, mismatched furniture including a worn leather couch and beanbag chairs, tangled cables, a broken espresso machine on a side table, warm ambient lighting
living_room.style: cinematic, golden hour, warm ambient lighting, lived-in tech apartment

kitchen.trigger_word: Small galley kitchen in a San Francisco apartment, cluttered countertops with smart home gadgets, a tablet mounted on the fridge showing notifications, coffee mugs with tech company logos, morning light streaming through a small window, cozy and lived-in
kitchen.style: cinematic, soft morning light, kitchen sitcom, warm tones

maya_desk.trigger_word: Corner desk setup in a San Francisco apartment, three monitors showing code and terminal windows, mechanical keyboard with custom keycaps, desk lamp casting warm light, energy drink cans, sticky notes everywhere, a small succulent plant, late night atmosphere
maya_desk.style: cinematic, warm desk lamp, monitor glow, late night, shallow depth of field

hallway.trigger_word: Narrow apartment hallway with coats hanging on hooks, shoes piled by the door, a smart doorbell with a blinking red light, package boxes stacked against the wall, overhead fluorescent light
hallway.style: cinematic, fluorescent overhead, narrow corridor, sitcom hallway

rooftop.trigger_word: San Francisco apartment building rooftop at dusk, panoramic city skyline view with fog rolling in, string lights hung between posts, a couple of folding chairs and a small table, the Bay Bridge glowing in the background, cinematic golden hour lighting
rooftop.style: cinematic, golden hour to dusk, fog, string lights, wide panorama

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of Maya's desk in the dead of night, monitors glowing red
beats.action: The corner of the apartment is lit only by the cascading red of failing test logs across three monitors; Maya is hunched at the desk, framed small against the wall of error output

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (panicked) No. No no no no no. The deployment is in twelve hours.
beats.camera: close-up on face, monitor glow illuminating features, slow zoom in
beats.action: Maya stares at her monitor in disbelief, her face lit by the blue glow of cascading error logs, mouth slightly open in shock

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (frustrated, talking to herself) This was supposed to be a simple patch. A one-line fix. Who writes a one-line fix that breaks seventeen tests?
beats.camera: tight close-up, slight tilt to capture eye-rub
beats.action: Maya slowly removes her glasses and rubs her tired eyes, then puts them back on — the errors are still there

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (angry, staring at screen) Oh. I do. I wrote it. Three weeks ago at two in the morning.
beats.camera: medium shot from side, showing Maya and the three monitors
beats.action: Maya turns sharply back to the screen, jaw clenched, eyes locked on the git blame output illuminating her face

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (defeated, slumping back) Past Maya is the worst engineer I've ever worked with.
beats.camera: medium shot from side, showing Maya and the three monitors
beats.action: Maya slumps back in her chair, defeated, head tilted toward the ceiling, arms limp at her sides

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (resolute, sitting up straight) Okay. Okay. We can fix this. I just need coffee, a whiteboard, and someone who actually reads documentation.
beats.camera: medium shot tracking forward as Maya straightens
beats.action: Maya sits up straight with renewed determination, jaw set — she reaches for an empty energy drink can, finds it empty, tosses it aside

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (grabbing phone, dialing) Finn. Wake up. I need you. Now.
beats.camera: over-the-shoulder shot from behind monitors, phone in hand
beats.action: Maya grabs her phone from the desk, scrolling through contacts with urgency, her face illuminated by the phone screen

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the kitchen at morning
beats.action: Morning light streams through the small kitchen window over cluttered countertops covered in smart home gadgets; Derek at the counter, Priya at the table sketching

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (enthusiastic) Good morning, team! Big news. Our new pivot is going to be absolutely huge. We're doing blockchain for pets.
beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, capturing Derek at counter and Priya at table
beats.action: Derek stands at the kitchen counter in his blazer, scrolling through his phone with one hand and pouring coffee with the other — missing the mug entirely, coffee pooling on the counter

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (dry, not looking up) You said that about blockchain for plants last week.
beats.camera: two-shot of Priya and Derek, mild domestic exasperation
beats.action: Priya glances up from her sketchbook with mild annoyance, one eyebrow raised, as Derek enthusiastically waves his phone showing his PetCoin logo

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (confident) Plants don't have wallets, Priya. Pets have owners. Owners have wallets. It's simple economics.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek, phone raised
beats.action: Derek gestures confidently with his phone, coffee still dripping off the counter behind him unnoticed

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (sarcastic) Right. Because what every dog needs is a crypto portfolio.
beats.camera: medium shot of Priya at table
beats.action: Priya deadpans without looking up from her sketchbook, pencil never pausing

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (defensive) It's called PetCoin. We're pre-revenue but post-vision.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek adjusting blazer
beats.action: Derek adjusts his blazer with a self-satisfied smile, completely unbothered by the coffee puddle spreading on the counter

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (entering, alarmed) Has anyone else noticed that the thermostat just reported our living room temperature to three different servers?
beats.camera: tracking shot following Finn as he enters
beats.action: Finn bursts through the kitchen doorway in his Hawaiian shirt, eyes wide and alarmed, clutching his phone like evidence at a crime scene

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (casual) I assumed it was a feature.
beats.camera: medium shot of Priya at table
beats.action: Priya sips her coffee calmly, not even looking up

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (anxious) One of those servers is in a country I cannot find on any map. I've checked four maps. Physical maps.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's phone screen, then his anxious face
beats.action: Finn holds up his phone showing a server location map, eyes darting between Priya and Derek for validation

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (dismissive) Finn, you've got to stop auditing the smart home devices. It's weird.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek leaning on counter
beats.action: Derek waves dismissively while checking something on his phone, the coffee puddle now reaching the edge of the counter

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (insistent) Derek, our coffee maker sent a firmware update request to the toaster at three AM. Those devices shouldn't even know each other exist.
beats.camera: three-shot, Finn center-frame between Derek and Priya
beats.action: Finn stands in the center of the kitchen, arms spread in exasperation as Derek grins and Priya deadpans

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (deadpan) Maybe they're in love.
beats.camera: close-up on Priya's face, perfect comedic timing
beats.action: Priya looks up from her sketchbook with the faintest smirk, delivery perfectly dry

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (horrified) That is not funny. That is a security vulnerability.
beats.camera: medium shot of Finn, aghast
beats.action: Finn's eyes go wide with genuine horror, clutching his phone to his chest

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (grinning) See, this is why I use blockchain. Immutable records. Your toaster can't lie to you on the blockchain.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek, arms spread like a pitch
beats.action: Derek leans against the counter, phone raised, grinning about blockchain — completely unaware of the coffee dripping onto his shoes

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (standing up) I'm going to the roof. With a pencil. The pencil has never betrayed me.
beats.camera: medium shot of Priya rising from the table
beats.action: Priya stands up from the table, tucking her sketchbook under her arm, shaking her head with a resigned smirk

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (calling after her) Check the smart lock on the roof door! I think it's been logging your bathroom breaks!
beats.camera: two-shot of Finn calling after Priya, Derek in background
beats.action: Finn calls after her, one hand cupped around his mouth, while Derek finally notices the coffee puddle and shrugs

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the living room
beats.action: The living room glows in golden hour light through the panoramic window; tech clutter everywhere, whiteboard with crossed-out diagrams, the broken espresso machine on the side table

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (urgent) Okay, I need everyone to stop whatever they're doing. We have a code red.
beats.camera: wide pan to Maya bursting through the entrance
beats.action: Maya bursts through the living room entrance, laptop clutched under her arm, hair disheveled from hours at the desk, eyes wild with urgency

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (not looking up) Is it actual code red or Maya-code-red where the button color is wrong?
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek on couch
beats.action: Derek doesn't even look up from his phone, still practicing his pitch to an invisible audience on the couch

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (irritated) The deployment pipeline has seventeen failing tests, the authentication module thinks it's nineteen seventy, and our CEO just texted asking if we can also add a chatbot by tomorrow.
beats.camera: two-shot of Maya facing Derek, intensity rising
beats.action: Maya stands fists clenched, laptop screen visible showing a wall of red test failures, her frustration mounting

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (standing up, interested) Did you say nineteen seventy? That's a Unix epoch issue. Someone forgot to convert the timestamp.
beats.camera: medium shot of Finn rising from the floor
beats.action: Finn stands up from where he was crouching by a smart plug with a magnifying glass, his bewildered expression sharpening into analytical focus

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (pointing at Finn) Yes! That's why I need you. You find bugs like a truffle pig finds truffles.
beats.camera: two-shot of Maya and Finn
beats.action: Maya points at Finn with desperate relief, finally someone who understands the code

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (flattered but concerned) I appreciate the compliment, but truffle pigs get eaten eventually.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's worried face
beats.action: Finn looks simultaneously flattered and deeply concerned, eyebrows knit together

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (standing, adjusting blazer) I can help too. I'm very good at standing near monitors and looking productive.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek rising from couch
beats.action: Derek stands from the couch, adjusting his blazer with practiced ease, offering himself up with a confident grin

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (skeptical) Derek, you once pushed to production on a Friday and then went to Burning Man.
beats.camera: two-shot of Maya and Derek, Maya's arms crossed
beats.action: Maya crosses her arms, eyebrow raised, the skepticism dripping from her posture

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (nostalgic) That was the best deploy of my career. The site was down for three days and nobody noticed because our users were also at Burning Man.
beats.camera: close-up on Derek's dreamy expression
beats.action: Derek gazes into the middle distance with genuine nostalgia, a warm smile spreading across his face

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (pulling out laptop) I'm in. But I have conditions. First, no deploying anything after midnight. Second, all error messages must be grammatically correct. Third—
beats.camera: over-the-shoulder of Finn at his laptop, code scrolling
beats.action: Finn pulls out his laptop and begins typing rapidly, his bewildered expression sharpening into focus

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (cutting him off) Finn. Focus. Can you fix the epoch bug or not?
beats.camera: two-shot of Maya and Finn, Maya stepping closer
beats.action: Maya steps closer, cutting through Finn's conditions with sharp focus

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (typing rapidly) I've already found it. Line four hundred and twelve. Someone hardcoded the year as a two-digit integer.
beats.camera: over-the-shoulder shot, Finn's fingers flying across keyboard
beats.action: Finn's fingers fly across the keyboard, code scrolling rapidly, his eyes locked on the screen

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (relieved but horrified) A two-digit... who does that?
beats.camera: close-up on Maya's face, relief and horror mixing
beats.action: Maya's face cycles through relief and dawning horror

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (looking at her) The git blame says it was you. Three weeks ago. At two fourteen AM.
beats.camera: two-shot of Finn pointing at Maya, Maya covering face
beats.action: Finn looks up from the screen and points at Maya — the git blame reveals it was her code

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (head in hands) Past Maya strikes again.
beats.camera: close-up on Maya burying her face
beats.action: Maya buries her face in her hands, groaning

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (cheerful) This is why I never write code. Can't have bugs if you never commit.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek on the couch, Maya and Finn in foreground
beats.action: Derek leans back on the couch, adjusting his blazer with a self-satisfied grin, arms spread wide

beats.camera: wide shot of two-person desk setup, monitors glowing red with failing tests
beats.action: Maya and Finn sit side by side at the desk, both hunched forward, illuminated by the harsh glow of multiple monitors showing cascading red test failures

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (analyzing) Okay, the epoch bug is fixed. But now I'm seeing something else. Your authentication tokens expire in negative four seconds.
beats.camera: medium close, showing the energy-drink fortress accumulating
beats.action: Finn points at a specific line on screen while Maya types furiously, empty energy drink cans accumulating around their keyboards

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (confused) Negative four? That's not even possible.
beats.camera: close-up on Maya's confused face
beats.action: Maya squints at the screen, head tilted, genuinely baffled

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (matter-of-fact) And yet, here we are. Your login system is rejecting users before they even try to log in. It's predictive authentication denial.
beats.camera: medium shot of Finn with monitor reflection in glasses
beats.action: Finn adjusts his glasses with academic detachment, explaining the impossible with clinical precision

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (typing) Is that a real term?
beats.camera: over-the-shoulder of Maya's monitor
beats.action: Maya's fingers pause over the keyboard, glancing sideways at Finn

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (proud) I just invented it. But it perfectly describes what's happening.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's proud smirk
beats.action: Finn sits up a little straighter, unable to suppress a flicker of pride

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (leaning back) Okay, what else? Give me the full damage report.
beats.camera: medium shot showing both characters and monitors
beats.action: Maya leans back in her chair, bracing herself

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (reading from screen) The database migration created a table called 'undefined'. The search function returns results from a completely different product. And the user profile page shows everyone the same photo of a labrador retriever.
beats.camera: push in to close-up on Finn's face, expression shifting from analytical to amused
beats.action: Finn reads the damage report with clinical precision, his expression shifting from analytical to amused

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (beat) That last one might actually improve the user experience.
beats.camera: close-up on Maya, brief laugh then composure
beats.action: Maya laughs despite herself, then quickly composes her face back to determined focus

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (nodding) The labrador has a four point eight star rating.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn nodding sincerely
beats.action: Finn nods with complete sincerity, as if this is the most normal thing in the world

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (laughing despite herself) Okay, okay. Focus. How many of the seventeen tests can we fix in the next... (checking time) ...nine hours?
beats.camera: two-shot, medium close, Maya checking phone
beats.action: Maya checks the time on her phone, her expression shifting from amusement to steel

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (counting) Fourteen. Three of them require a database schema change that would take down production for twenty minutes.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's fingers counting on screen
beats.action: Finn counts off on his fingers, eyes scanning the test list methodically

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (determined) Then we deploy at three AM when nobody's awake.
beats.camera: close-up on Maya, eyes locked forward
beats.action: Maya sits up straight with steel in her eyes — nine hours to fix fourteen tests

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (nervous) Except me. I'm always awake at three AM. That's when the smart home devices have their meetings.
beats.camera: two-shot, Finn leaning in conspiratorially
beats.action: Finn leans in, lowering his voice as if sharing classified intelligence

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (staring at him) Their... meetings.
beats.camera: two-shot, Maya's deadpan reaction
beats.action: Maya stares at Finn for a long beat, processing what he just said

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (dead serious) Network traffic spikes at three twelve AM every night. Twelve devices. Synchronized. I have charts.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn, completely serious
beats.action: Finn holds Maya's gaze with absolute conviction — he is not joking

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (choosing to ignore this) Let's just fix the code, Finn.
beats.camera: two-shot, lingering reaction, Maya turning back to keyboard
beats.action: Maya deliberately turns back to her keyboard, choosing sanity over curiosity

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the living room in the late evening
beats.action: The living room is in late-evening light; whiteboard covered in crossed-out diagrams; takeout containers scattered; the four roommates assembled

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (cautiously hopeful) It's... working. The tests are passing. All seventeen.
beats.camera: group shot, medium wide, all four in frame, whiteboard behind Maya
beats.action: Maya stands by the whiteboard, eyes bright with cautious hope, laptop screen reflected in her glasses showing green checkmarks

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (suspicious) All of them? Even test number nine? Test number nine has never passed. I'm convinced it was written by a ghost.
beats.camera: medium shot of Finn on the floor looking up from laptop
beats.action: Finn looks up from his laptop on the floor, suspicious — his eyes narrow at the screen

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (checking) Yes. Even test number nine. We might actually deploy on time.
beats.camera: close-up on Maya's laptop screen, then her face
beats.action: Maya scrolls through the test results, a disbelieving smile forming

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (pumping fist) See? All you needed was vibes. I told you the energy in this apartment was off. I burned sage this morning.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek on couch, fist pumping
beats.action: Derek pumps his fist from the couch, beaming with unearned satisfaction

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (skeptical) That was a kitchen accident, Derek. You set fire to a dish towel.
beats.camera: two-shot of Priya and Derek
beats.action: Priya fixes Derek with a withering stare, arms crossed

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (dismissive) Intentional sage. Anyway, I also want credit for providing moral support and excellent blazer energy.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek adjusting blazer
beats.action: Derek adjusts his blazer lapels with a flamboyant gesture

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (to Maya) He literally did nothing to help. He spent three hours on a pitch deck for PetCoin.
beats.camera: medium shot of Priya gesturing at Derek
beats.action: Priya gestures at Derek with exasperated precision

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (showing phone) Which is looking incredible, by the way. We've got a logo now. It's a dog with sunglasses holding Bitcoin. Priya, you'd love the UX.
beats.camera: medium shot of Derek with phone held high, Priya recoiling
beats.action: Derek holds up his phone showing a dog-with-sunglasses logo, beaming with pride

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (disgusted) I would not love the UX. I can already tell the UX is terrible.
beats.camera: close-up on Priya's disgusted face
beats.action: Priya recoils in aesthetic disgust, one hand raised as if to block the phone from her vision

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (interrupting) Can we please focus? I'm about to deploy. This is the moment. Finn, are we clear?
beats.camera: medium shot of Maya, hands on laptop
beats.action: Maya cuts through the chaos, finger hovering over the enter key, eyes sharp

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (slowly) Everything looks clean on my end. But I should mention that the smart fridge just autonomously ordered forty pounds of artisanal cheese.
beats.camera: tight on Finn's phone screen showing the cheese order, then Derek's horror
beats.action: Finn slowly turns his phone around, showing a confirmation email for forty pounds of artisanal cheese

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (beat) What?
beats.camera: close-up on Maya's baffled face
beats.action: Maya's face cycles through confusion and disbelief

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (showing phone) It found a deal. Apparently, our fridge has been price-comparing gouda on six different websites. It used Derek's credit card.
beats.camera: medium shot of Finn calmly presenting evidence
beats.action: Finn holds up his phone showing itemized cheese orders across six retailers

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (horrified) WHAT? How does the fridge know my credit card?
beats.camera: close-up on Derek's horrified face
beats.action: Derek's face cycles through confusion to horror as he pats his pockets for his wallet

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (calm) You stored it in a browser that syncs cookies to every device in the apartment. Including the fridge.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's matter-of-fact expression
beats.action: Finn delivers this with the calm authority of a forensic accountant

beats.speaker: priya
beats.text: (smirking) The blockchain would have prevented this.
beats.camera: close-up on Priya's smirk
beats.action: Priya smirks, savoring the moment with exquisite timing

beats.speaker: derek
beats.text: (panicked) That's not— that's not how blockchain works!
beats.camera: close-up on Derek sputtering
beats.action: Derek sputters defensively, hands raised in futile protest

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (finger hovering over enter key) I'm deploying. Three... two... one...
beats.camera: close-up on Maya's finger hovering over the enter key, then pull back to the group
beats.action: Maya counts down, finger presses enter, the room holds its breath, all four faces frozen in a mix of terror and anticipation

beats.camera: close-up on monitor showing green deployment success
beats.action: A monitor fills the frame displaying a green deployment success screen — silent, glowing, victorious

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (exhausted but triumphant) We did it. Version two point four is live. No crashes. No errors. No labrador.
beats.camera: slow pull back to reveal Maya and Finn
beats.action: Maya is slumped in her chair, exhausted but smiling softly at the green screen

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (wistful) I'm going to miss the labrador.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's wistful face
beats.action: Finn sits beside her, equally spent, chin propped on his hand, a genuine note of loss in his voice

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (sleepy) Me too, honestly. He had kind eyes.
beats.camera: two-shot, intimate framing, warm desk lamp light
beats.action: Maya's eyes are half-closed with quiet satisfaction, a faint smile on her lips

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (after a pause) Maya?
beats.camera: two-shot, quiet beat
beats.action: Finn glances at Maya, who is drifting off, then back at his phone

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (half asleep) Hmm?
beats.camera: close-up on Maya, eyes barely open
beats.action: Maya mumbles, eyes barely open, head listing slightly

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (quietly concerned) The cheese has arrived. All forty pounds of it. It's in the hallway.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn looking at phone with concern
beats.action: Finn looks at his phone with a mixture of concern and bewilderment, then glances toward the door

beats.speaker: maya
beats.text: (mumbling, falling asleep) Ship it...
beats.camera: close-up on Maya, lips moving as her eyes drift shut
beats.action: Maya mumbles and her eyes drift shut, a peaceful smile on her face

beats.speaker: finn
beats.text: (to himself, looking at phone) Also, the smart doorbell just complimented the delivery driver's shirt. I... I don't know how to report that bug.
beats.camera: close-up on Finn's phone screen, then up to his face
beats.action: Finn stares at his phone screen, then slowly looks up at the camera with a completely lost expression

beats.camera: wide hold on the desk, monitors glowing, fade to black
beats.action: The room falls silent, the apartment hums around them, the monitors glow on — slow fade to black
